_comment: Calibration corpus. Each entry pins a product to a SCORE BAND, not an exact number,
so recalibration is allowed but silent drift is not. Bands are inclusive.
Verdict bands from score.js BANDS: 90+ Excellent, 75-89 Good, 50-74 Mediocre,
Products marked "defect" encode the CORRECT answer for a known open bug and are
expected to fail until that bug is fixed. corpus.test.js reports them separately
and does not count them as failures while the defect is listed in OPEN_DEFECTS.
Ingredient text is representative of the real product panel, transcribed by hand.
Sources for the seed set are the products named throughout the engine comments.
